mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.8% over the next month predicts a monetary easing cycle, reducing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5% from its current 4.0%, a strong labor market signal emerges, boosting investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of UNRATE <3.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p >0.05) or the effect diminishes below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in INDPRO (supply) and GDPC1 (demand) create a virtuous cycle of economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) when both proxies rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS increasing), an unexpected decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.9% triggers a reversal in policy expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not revert to the tightening trend within 60 days, or the 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) above 5% growth forecasts stronger corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth does not sustain above 5% for 20 days, or returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS (payrolls) exceeds 150,000 from its current 148,912, a robust labor market signal emerges, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 150,000 in the next 5 days, or returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in INDPRO (supply) and HOUST (housing demand) above their 10-week moving averages signal robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) when both proxies rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.8% and UNRATE below 4.0% creates a dual labor-monetary easing signal, amplifying equity market optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction (FEDFUNDS <1.8 AND UNRATE <4.0) does not occur within the next 20 days, or the 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when the interaction is active.
